conditions: The first clause concerns generic package declarations. The second concerns packages classified as library units.
limitations: A generic formal part can contain zero generic formal parameter declarations.
A package can also be nested. This claim covers separate compilation only for packages that are library units.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: The Ada 2022 Reference Manual documents generic package declarations with a formal part and identifies packages as one possible kind of separately compiled library unit.
